name: @texit/desktop
author: Fernando Daza (https://github.com/fernandevdaza)

scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run copy:web
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never

//: Everything is bundled by esbuild into dist-electron/, so all packages are devDependencies (electron-builder then ships no node_modules).
